name: ens-both-ways
description: Alice makes a Swarm ID account secured with the wallet the ENS snapshot named flowkit-alice.solarpunkid.eth, turns on Show my ENS name on sites and signs in to the viewer, and Bob makes one with a passkey in the sign-in window. Alice sends a message: Bob must see her ENS name with the Swarm ID badge, and in its details the ENS row with the checked tick and her chosen name. Alice turns the setting off and signs in again, after which her next message must show her chosen name and no ENS row, while the first keeps her ENS name. The setting reaches the viewer only at a sign-in, which ens-off-while-signed-in holds as a known finding.
steps: expect sender bob "with my ENS name {run}" name=ens:alice badge=swarm-id ens=shown
expect details bob "with my ENS name {run}" identity=swarm-id sent=gateway ens=alice
expect sender bob "with my chosen name {run}" name=chosen:alice badge=swarm-id ens=none
expect details bob "with my chosen name {run}" identity=swarm-id ens=none
expect sender bob "with my ENS name {run}" name=ens:alice badge=swarm-id ens=shown
